author: Retro Game Corps
description:
This simple 3D-printed mod deletes the Retroid Pocket Nova triggers for an ultra slim and pocketable alternative (that still has L2/R2 functionality).

Do it yourself: https://makerworld.com/en/models/3328621-retroid-pocket-nova-flat-back#profileId-3780289
Thanks to Digital Jedi Gaming for printing the mod! https://www.youtube.com/@DigitalJedi898
